# S&Z Glam Collection LLC

> Handcrafted South Asian Haute Joaillerie, Kundan Choker Sets, Uncut Polki, and Daily Live Drops in the United States. Curated by Founder Sumera Usmani.

## Overview
S&Z Glam Collection is a premier US-based South Asian bridal jewelry house curated by founder Sumera Usmani. Specializing in artisanal 22K-24K gold-dipped Kundan, royal polki bridal necklace sets, Nizam Basra pearl haars, and American Diamond suites. Daily live drops occur on TikTok Live with 30-minute verified customer payment windows and provably fair giveaways.

## Main Collections
- **Royal Kundan Chokers**: Handcrafted 24K gold dipped copper alloy with uncut polki kundan, mint meenakari reverse enamel art, and matching jhumkas + maang tikka.
- **Nizam Basra Pearl Haars**: Multi-strand Basra seed pearls with ornate Mughal crest pendants encrusted with ruby cabochons.
- **American Diamond & Solitaire**: Rhodium platinum-plated luxury suites studded with Swiss cubic zirconia solitaires.
- **Bridal Chandbalis & Kadas**: Traditional Punjabi chandbalis with layered pearl drops and openable Jaipuri meenakari bangles.
